articles.title: BMC Floats Tender For ₹13,000-Crore Mumbai Flood Mitigation Plan To Tackle Chronic Monsoon Waterlogging
articles.description: The BMC has floated a tender to appoint a consultant for a ₹13,000-crore integrated flood-mitigation plan to tackle Mumbai’s monsoon waterlogging. The consultant will prepare a detailed project report within nine months covering drainage upgrades, pumping capacity, flood warnings and infrastructure improvements. The plan also includes nature-based measures and waste interception systems.
